name: Square MCP
description: Gives agents the Square commerce API over a hosted OAuth MCP server — payments, orders, catalog, invoices, and bookings with granular permission scopes.

skills.name: Payment Operations
skills.description: Creates and inspects payments and refunds against a Square merchant account through scoped OAuth access.

skills.name: Catalog Management
skills.description: Reads and edits the product catalog, including items, variations, and inventory counts across locations.

skills.name: Order Lifecycle
skills.description: Creates, updates, and queries orders and invoices so agents can drive a transaction from cart to settlement.
